added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest declares no baseline_suite or after_suite keys, and the run's own revision-keyed gate logs supply the pair: logs/s5-gate.log at f3141903 reports 6 passed with no failing id, and logs/repair-gate.log at cd8ea00a reports 87 passed with EXIT=0, so the head arm adds no failing id.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Removing self._last_logged_settings = settings at imas_ambix/agent/router.py:1168 makes the second settings() call log again, so len(logged) reads 2 and line 198 fails; logs/repair-negative-control.log shows exactly that red on a copy of cd8ea00a with the assignment removed.
assertion_review.independence: The count is over the logger's own records rather than a value the test hands to the gate; the only thing supplied is the control file's JSON, an input rather than the expected outcome.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: Dropping wait_bound_seconds from the published router_generation_gate document reddens the exact-dict comparison at line 575; the key was added to the expectation because cd8ea00a publishes the new field.
assertion_review.independence: The expected dict is written out in the test and the value 30.0 is the production default, so a production change to the key or its value reddens it.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: A bound that stops closing slots leaves the settled assertion at line 174 false and the closed list at lines 177-179 empty, so the arm fails; the unbounded arm at line 169 crosses 45 s only because the closure is what reddens the bounded run, so disabling the closure reddens line 169 as well.
assertion_review.independence: The window percentile is cut by _rank_p90 at line 138, a separate copy of the nearest-rank rule, so an estimator regression moves production only and the assertion still fails.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: The test now passes wait_bound_seconds=None so the runaway measured is the unbound rule's; with the bound at its default the closure holds the pool and the last-hour mean asked for at line 276 falls below RUNAWAY_WORKERS, which is the failure the head gate's passing run rules out.
assertion_review.independence: The threshold RUNAWAY_WORKERS is a module constant rather than a figure the test supplies to the simulation, so the assertion still fails if the rule stops running away in the unbounded configuration it names.

evidence_limits: The reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite keys, so the added-failure count is taken from the run's own two revision-keyed gate logs rather than from declared arms.

logs/margin-seeds.log:18 records the margin-2.8 seed-1 bound arm at 48.25 s, so the bound holds every settled window under 45 s on the reported seed 0 only; the fragment discloses this beside its pass table.
The estimator unification is verified by a grep count in the negative-control log, not by a test.
No suite or mutation rerun was performed during this bounded read-only review; the reviewed negative-control log is read as recorded.
